name: YLY-web-sm
description: Social Media committee edition: offline-first PWA with a /50 technical score, exported into the SMMEMBER template.

paragraphs: The Social Media committee edition: offline-first PWA with a /50 technical score, visits and meetings, scored out of 110 and exported into the real SMMEMBER Excel template.

An offline-first member evaluation dashboard (Web + installable PWA) for the Social Media committee, built with Clean Architecture. Every evaluator's data lives only on their own device (IndexedDB in the browser) — there is no backend: scores are computed on-device, the committee's real SMMEMBER.xlsx Excel template is filled in the browser, and reports are shared through a WhatsApp deep link. A leader dashboard then merges every evaluator's file into one master report.

Part of the YLY evaluation suite. Each committee has its own deployment with its own template and weighting. Instead of itemised tasks it uses a single technical evaluation worth 50 points, the heaviest single category in the suite. Sibling editions: EHI/HR · PR · OER · the original React/Vite prototype lives in YLY-web.
features: 📴 Offline-first — every mutation hits IndexedDB only; refresh or lose the network and the data is still there.
🏆 Leaderboard of all members, sorted by total /110, with percentage and A–F grade badges.
📅 Global events — field visits (name, date, Day/Night shift) and meetings created once and scored per member.
🧠 Technical evaluation out of 50 per member.
🎚️ Category scores (Interaction, Respect Hierarchy, Bonus) — each with its own Save button.

requirements.text: No server, no API keys: WaMeDeepLinkBuilder builds which opens WhatsApp with the report pre-filled (attachments must be added manually).
